capabilities.name: Manual CPR
capabilities.note: Needs a restrained patient (CMRS) or the Evetts-Russomano or handstand method

source.doc: Hinkelbein J, et al. CPR during spaceflight: a guideline for CPR in microgravity. Scand J Trauma Resusc Emerg Med 2020;28:108

capabilities.name: Gravity-fed IV drip
capabilities.note: No gravity to drive flow; use a pressure infuser

capabilities.name: Major surgery (e.g. appendectomy)
capabilities.note: Outside the exploration treatment scope in the IMM CLiFFs

source.doc: IMM CLiFF ICL8 Appendicitis (2023), Capability Resource Table overview

capabilities.name: CT or X-ray imaging
capabilities.note: CT 'will likely not be available' per the IMM CLiFFs

source.doc: IMM CLiFF ICL8 Appendicitis (2023), Capability Resource Table overview

capabilities.name: Blood tests (CBC with differential, metabolic panel)
capabilities.note: Not in the IMM kit lists; the 2023 CLiFFs assume these will be possible on exploration missions

source.doc: IMM CLiFF ICL8 Appendicitis (2023), Capability Resource Table overview

capabilities.name: Blood transfusion
capabilities.note: No blood products in any IMM kit list

source.doc: IMM SR S-20180815-406 (Orion Medical Kit Contents), Table 2, 20 lb + 13,721 cm3 optimized kit

notes: The IMM's 20 lb / 13,721 cm3 optimized kit, which the 2024 Lunar request reused for Orion. A 20 lb kit with no volume limit (9.25 kg) adds IV fluid, a SAM splint and the variable oxygen system. An optimizer result, not the flown kit. Check Orion's current flight status before citing it.
